_comment: The captain's gear (docs/archive/PROGRESSION.md P1). slot: weapon, shield, body, helm, horse. A weapon sets damage, reach, windup and recover; armour adds to the captain troop's armour and speed; a shield sets the block chance; a horse names a mount in troops.json. needs = the level of `skill` (Arms unless named) to use it, rank = the career rank to buy it (0 free company, 1 sworn sword, 2 vassal, 3 lord). look = the sprite part (weapon, shield, body or head).

gear.name: Arming Sword
gear.text: A plain, quick blade. Good with a shield.

gear.name: Longsword
gear.text: More reach than the arming sword, as quick.

gear.name: War Axe
gear.text: Short and heavy. Bites through mail.

gear.name: Flanged Mace
gear.text: Short, but plate does little against it.

gear.name: Boar Spear
gear.text: Longest reach on foot. Thrusts only.

gear.name: Greatsword
gear.text: Two hands, no shield. Only a parry stops a blow cleanly.

gear.name: Dane Axe
gear.text: Slow, and splits a helm. Two hands, no shield.

gear.name: Hunting Bow
gear.text: Shoot from the saddle or on foot. 24 arrows.

gear.name: War Bow
gear.text: A heavy draw that carries far. 24 arrows.

gear.name: Crossbow
gear.text: Slow to span, and punches through plate. 16 bolts.

gear.name: No Shield
gear.text: A free hand. Parry or take the blow.

gear.name: Round Shield
gear.text: Light and cheap.

gear.name: Heater Shield
gear.text: A knight's shield.

gear.name: Kite Shield
gear.text: Covers the legs too. A little heavier.

gear.name: Gambeson
gear.text: Quilted cloth. Light and quick.

gear.name: Mail Hauberk
gear.text: Rings from neck to knee.

gear.name: Plate Armour
gear.text: Steel from head to toe.

gear.name: Lord's Harness
gear.text: Fitted plate for a lord. Better and lighter.

gear.name: Kettle Hat
gear.text: A brimmed iron hat. Wide view.

gear.name: Sallet
gear.text: A swept steel helm.

gear.name: Spangenhelm
gear.text: Banded and riveted.

gear.name: Great Helm
gear.text: A closed steel helm.

gear.name: Courser
gear.text: A quick riding horse.

gear.name: Steppe Horse
gear.text: Tough and tireless.

gear.name: Warhorse
gear.text: Bred for battle.

gear.name: Destrier
gear.text: A great horse in cloth barding.

gear.name: Barded Destrier
gear.text: A destrier in steel and cloth, for a vassal.
